title: MVP or Prototype? A Guide to Choosing the Right Approach for Your Idea | HatchWorks AI
description: Prototypes and MVPs are important tools in product development, but they serve different purposes. Prototypes are used to test and refine design ideas, while MVPs are used to test market demand for a minimal product. Both have benefits and drawbacks, and the right approach for a product depends on its goals.
